steps.name: Given I am on the login page
When I enter "saad@cartpanda.com" in email field
And I enter "Vista123+@" in password field
And I click on Signin button
Then I should see Select store Page
When I click on "msaad" button
Then I should see Dashboard Page
Then I click on Product btn in sidebar
And I click on Kits from the Products dropdown
Then I click on Add Kits button
Then I click on Kits name input field and enter the name of the Kits "MULTIPLE KITS PRODUCTS(DIGITAL)"
Then I click on the search field
Then I click on product search field and enter "TESTPDF"
Then I select the searched product from the list
Then I click on Select button
And I check Product and Discounts
And I enter the "10" discount amount in the discount field
Then I click on Add products
Then I click on the search field
Then I click on product search field and enter "AIRPODS PRO"
Then I select the searched product from the list
Then I click on Select button
And I check Customized
